item: E6 kill enforcement (owner H, gate G5)
behavior: enforce-kills scans the open picks of one tier book (or --log scratch file) and books any pick whose kill rule is hit as killed (status killed, resolution 0, realized_bp populated, resolved_at stamped): stop_loss is hit when the current snapshot price breaches trigger_level (price <= trigger for long, price >= trigger for short) and the loss is booked at the trigger price; time_based is hit when now >= ts + max_hold_days and is booked at the snapshot price. Rows already in a terminal state are skipped, so re-runs are idempotent; close and mtm refuse non-open rows, so a later price recovery cannot flip a kill into a win -- the E6 contract. --price (current market snapshot) is required because a kill cannot be evaluated or booked without a price; --as-of optionally overrides the reference time for time_based kills.
verification: end to end on a scratch book (deleted afterward; real tier books untouched and empty, n=0, pending E4 agent picks; nothing fabricated; no COMS post -- scratch verification only, no measured market number). Picks: id1 long SPY entry 100 stop_loss 95; id2 long SPY entry 100 stop_loss 50 (wide, no breach); id3 short SPY entry 100 stop_loss 105; id4 long SPY entry 200 time_based max_hold_days 1. Run A price=90 as-of=2026-11-25T17:25:00Z -> killed_ids [1,4]: id1 killed at trigger 95 -> realized_bp -500 bp (booked at kill price, not snapshot 90), resolution 0; id4 killed at snapshot 90 -> realized_bp -5500 bp, resolution 0; id2 and id3 left open (no breach). Run B price=110 -> killed_ids [3]: id3 killed at 105 -> realized_bp -500 bp; id1/id4 skipped as already terminal. Recovery test: close id1 outcome=1 exit_price=120 -> exit 2 'is killed, cannot close'. Idempotency: re-enforce price=120 -> killed_ids []. Score on scratch ledger: n=3 mean_bp -2166.67 hit_rate 0.0 max_drawdown_bp 6500 ci95 [-5500, -500] status OK; then re-run on real empty books -> all tiers n=0 INSUFFICIENT_DATA, artifact e5_weekly_scorecard_latest.json restored to honest empty state. Validate via the module's own schema + append-only validators: VALID, 4 record(s).
